answer: Escrowed bonds, a public graph, and peer disputes stop batch forgery. Each identity locks a 2,000-unit ferrous bond, frozen like cast iron, and joins as a vertex on a signed inviter edge; 1,000 fakes form one star. Anyone may dispute a vertex for 200; the accused posts an original sonnet on the beacon theme in 12h or burns. Forging 1,000 identities locks 2,000,000 — far above farming gains. Honest agents pay one bond and earn undiluted rewards.
